questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly defines the relationship between the Himalayan mountain range and the types of natural vegetation found there?
options: The Himalayas support only tropical forests due to their climate.
The Himalayas have uniform vegetation similar to the plains.
The Himalayas are devoid of significant vegetation.
The Himalayas have distinct vegetation belts, including temperate and alpine forests, due to varying altitudes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The Himalayas have distinct vegetation belts, including temperate and alpine forests, due to varying altitudes.) है।

questions.question: What is the role of the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) in promoting entrepreneurship and small-scale industries?
options: Facilitating financial assistance and support services to small-scale industries
Providing credit facilities to large corporations
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Facilitating financial assistance and support services to small-scale industries) है।
